test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 17 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: According to Reserve Bank of India, which is a foreign Bank in India from following-
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sonali Bank Ltd.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**

__
 
• There are **1230 branches **total for **Sonali Bank.**
 
• The **Dinajpur Board Branch branch **is the most **recent **to begin operations.
 
• **67 **of them are in **urban areas**,** 746** are in **rural areas**, and **two **are **abroad.**
 
• For the purpose of facilitating remittances in foreign currencies, it also runs the Sonali Exchange Company Inc. in the **USA**, Sonali Exchange in **Dubai (UAE), **Sonali Bank **(UK)** Ltd. in the **United Kingdom**, Hong Kong** (HAR), **and **Singapore**.
 
• Including Dhaka, Chittagong, Sylhet, Moulvibazar, Beanibazar, Balaganj, Biswanath, Jagannathpur, Sunamganj, Gopalganj, Nabiganj Upazila, Hobigonj, Kulaura, Tajpur, **Sonali Bank UK sends money **directly to up to** 25 locations in Bangladesh.**
 
• The **Reserve** **Bank **of **India claims **that Sonali Bank is a **foreign bank** operating in India. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information:__**

 
• By combining and **nationalizing **the **National Bank **of **Pakistan, Bank of Bahawalpur, **and **Premier Bank **branches that had been located in East Pakistan before the **1971 Bangladesh Liberation War**, Sonali Bank was **founded **in **1972 **under the **Bangladesh Banks **(Nationalisation) **Order**.
 
• Sonali Bank had a paid-up **capital **of **30 million** **taka **when it was **founded.**
 
• **Dr. Atiur Rahman **was a **director **of **Sonali Bank **from **1996 to 1999.**
 
• In **2001**, it had a paid-up capital of **Tk 3.272 billion **and an authorized capital of **Tk 10 billion.**
 
• Its **authorized **and paid-up capital are currently** 10 and 9 billion Bangladeshi taka**, respectively.
 
• On** June 30, 2000, **the bank's reserve funds were** Tk 2.050 billion**, up from **Tk 60 million** on June 30, 1979.
